newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gran Canaria cargo traffic fell 6.8 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Gran Canaria cargo traffic fell 6.8 pct in August.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Gran Canaria airport fell 6.8 percent in August to 2,003 tonnes, compared with the same month last year, airport figures show.
But volumes in the first eight months of this year were still 2.9 percent ahead of 1995 at 22,183 tonnes.
Domestic cargo business in August was 2.8 percent down at 1,681 tonnes, while international freight traffic fell 23 percent to 322 tonnes.
Mail, was 35 percent higher at 451 tonnes in the month.

Some 641,765 passengers passed through the airport in August, taking the eight month total to 5.17 million compared with 5.20 million last year. -- Air Cargo Newsroom tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
